item.title: Ankylosing Spondylitis & Holistic Care
item.description:
Ankylosing Spondylitis (AS) is a chronic inflammatory autoimmune condition that primarily affects the spine and sacroiliac (SI) joints. Over time, it leads to severe stiffness, loss of spinal mobility, and localized inflammation along the vertebral column.

How Acupuncture Aids Ankylosing Spondylitis

While AS requires a long-term management strategy, targeted acupuncture provides complementary relief by focusing on symptom management:

  • Modulating Inflammatory Pathways: Helps downregulate systemic and localized inflammatory responses around the sacroiliac joints.
  • Relieving Paraspinal Spasms: Eases persistent muscle tightness along the spine caused by chronic spinal guarding.
  • Improving Joint Mobility: Enhances blood flow (Qi and blood circulation) to stiff ligaments and surrounding tendons.
  • Endorphin Activation: Stimulates central nerve pathways to release endorphins, assisting with chronic night pain and stiffness.

Treatment Focus Areas

  1. Sacroiliac (SI) Joint & Lower Back: Targeted needle placement along the sacral region to improve hip and pelvic posture.
  2. Thoracic & Cervical Spine: Easing rigidity along the mid-to-upper back to preserve respiratory expansion and neck mobility.
